records.heading: Course overview and prerequisites
records.content: Naam: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads (Skillomate). Format: Hinglish, chhote video lessons, ek AI presenter. Lessons: 8. Example product: white 60% compact mechanical keyboard, red accent keys, price ₹2,599 (sirf example). Kiske liye: jo apna product online bechte hain, aur jo dusron ke liye product ads banana chahte hain. Zarurat: phone, laptop, koi bhi product.

translations.english: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project). You learn to create product photos, product videos and honest ads for your own products or clients. You need a phone, laptop and a product. Tools: Google Flow, ChatGPT and CapCut; a full CapCut editing tutorial is not taught. Course prompts are in lesson notes.
translations.hindi: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads में 8 पाठ हैं: 01 कोर्स परिचय; 02 फोन फोटो से स्टूडियो फोटो और प्रोडक्ट शीट; 03 मॉडल के साथ प्रोडक्ट, रेफरेंस और हाथों की गलतियाँ; 04 दिवाली, शादी के दृश्य और हर रंग की नई शीट; 05 ChatGPT से खरीदार, समस्या, विज्ञापन कोण, हुक, स्क्रिप्ट, कैप्शन और Flow prompts; 06 फोटो से प्रोडक्ट वीडियो, Ingredients में एक मूवमेंट; 07 ईमानदार फोन-स्टाइल UGC वीडियो; 08 पूरा वर्कफ़्लो, गलतियाँ, ईमानदारी और अंतिम प्रोजेक्ट। इससे अपने या ग्राहकों के प्रोडक्ट की तस्वीरें, वीडियो और ईमानदार विज्ञापन बनाना सीखते हैं। फोन, लैपटॉप और प्रोडक्ट चाहिए। टूल: Google Flow, ChatGPT और CapCut; पूरा CapCut एडिटिंग ट्यूटोरियल नहीं सिखाया जाता। प्रॉम्प्ट पाठ के नोट्स में हैं।
translations.hinglish: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads mein 8 lessons hain: 01 Course Intro; 02 phone photos se Product Sheet aur studio/lifestyle/dark premium photos; 03 model ke saath product, character reference aur hands; 04 Diwali, wedding scenes aur har colour ki nayi sheet; 05 ChatGPT se buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption aur Flow prompts; 06 Ingredients se ek movement wala product video; 07 honest phone-style UGC video; 08 poora workflow, mistakes, honesty aur final project. Apne ya clients ke liye product photos, videos aur honest ads banana seekhte ho. Phone, laptop aur product chahiye. Tools Google Flow, ChatGPT aur CapCut hain; full CapCut editing tutorial nahi sikhaya jata. Prompts lesson notes mein hain.

records.heading: Product sheet banana
records.content: • Phone se product ki 5–7 photos, alag angles, din ki roshni, flash off, details saaf. • Google Flow → New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. • Saari photos upload/reference mein lagao → product sheet prompt chalao. • Sheet achhi na aaye toh dobara generate karo. Achhi sheet ko save rakho — poore course mein yahi reference hai.

translations.english: Take 5–7 clear phone photos from different angles in daylight, with flash off. In Google Flow choose New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. Upload all photos as references and run the Product Sheet template. Review, regenerate if needed, and save the best sheet for later shots.
translations.hindi: दिन की रोशनी में, फ्लैश बंद करके अलग कोणों से प्रोडक्ट की 5–7 साफ़ तस्वीरें लें। Google Flow में New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro चुनें। सभी तस्वीरें reference में लगाकर Product Sheet प्रॉम्प्ट चलाएँ। परिणाम जाँचें, ज़रूरत हो तो फिर बनाएँ और अच्छी शीट सेव करें।
translations.hinglish: Din ki roshni mein flash off karke product ki 5–7 saaf photos alag angles se lo. Google Flow → New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro chuno. Sabhi photos reference mein upload karke Product Sheet prompt chalao. Result check karo, zarurat ho toh dobara banao aur achhi sheet save karo.

records.heading: Product photos
records.content: • Reference mein sirf product sheet. • Prompt ki pehli line: product bilkul waisa hi. • Phir scene: jagah, 2–3 cheezein, roshni, angle. Sajawat peeche, product aage.

translations.english: Use only the product sheet as reference. Start the prompt by keeping the product unchanged, then describe the place, 2–3 objects, lighting and angle. Keep decoration behind and the product in front.
translations.hindi: केवल प्रोडक्ट शीट को reference बनाएँ। पहले प्रोडक्ट को वैसा ही रखने की बात लिखें, फिर जगह, 2–3 वस्तुएँ, रोशनी और कोण बताएँ। सजावट पीछे और प्रोडक्ट आगे रखें।
translations.hinglish: Sirf product sheet ko reference banao. Pehle product bilkul same rakhne ko bolo, phir jagah, 2–3 objects, roshni aur angle likho. Sajawat peeche aur product aage rakho.

records.heading: Model shots
records.content: • Character sheet + product sheet dono reference mein. • Model ke kapde/look prompt mein sheet se match karke likho. • "natural hands with five fingers" likho. 2–3 versions banao.

translations.hindi: Character sheet और product sheet दोनों reference में लगाएँ। मॉडल के कपड़े और चेहरा character sheet से मिलाएँ। प्रॉम्प्ट में “natural hands with five fingers” लिखें। 2–3 परिणाम बनाकर जाँचें।
translations.hinglish: Character sheet aur product sheet dono reference mein lagao. Model ke kapde aur face sheet se match karo. Prompt mein “natural hands with five fingers” likho. 2–3 versions banao aur check karo.

records.heading: Colour variants
records.content: • Reference: product sheet. • "Only change the colour of [part] to [colour]. Keep everything else exactly the same." • Har rang ki poori sheet banao, aage ke shots usi se.

translations.english: Use the product sheet as reference. Change only the requested part’s colour and keep everything else unchanged: shape, layout, details, text, logo, views, background and lighting. Generate a complete new sheet for each colour and use that sheet in later shots.
translations.hindi: प्रोडक्ट शीट को reference रखें। केवल बताए गए हिस्से का रंग बदलें; आकार, बनावट, विवरण, टेक्स्ट, लोगो, चारों दृश्य, पृष्ठभूमि और रोशनी समान रखें। हर रंग की पूरी नई शीट बनाएँ और आगे उसी का उपयोग करें।
translations.hinglish: Product sheet reference mein rakho. Sirf bataye hue part ka rang badlo; shape, layout, details, text, logo, views, background aur light same rakho. Har rang ki poori nayi sheet banao aur aage usi ko use karo.

records.heading: Ad plan
records.content: • Ek hi chat mein: details + price + kahan bechte ho → 3 buyers, problems, angles. • Angle chuno → 5 hooks + 15-sec script + caption, "use only the features I gave you". • Flow ke 3 image prompts likhwao → Flow mein product sheet ke saath chalao. • Output padh ke jhoothe/unproven claims hatao.

translations.english: Provide real product details, price and where you sell. First ask for three buyer types, their problems and an ad angle for each. Choose one angle, then request 5 hooks, a 15-second script and an Instagram caption. Use only supplied features; add no unsupported claims. Next request 3 Google Flow image prompts and run them with the product sheet. Review and remove false or unproven claims.
translations.hindi: असली प्रोडक्ट विवरण, कीमत और बिक्री का माध्यम दें। पहले तीन प्रकार के खरीदार, उनकी समस्याएँ और हर खरीदार के लिए विज्ञापन का कोण पूछें। एक कोण चुनकर 5 hooks, 15-second script और Instagram caption माँगें। केवल दिए हुए फीचर्स रखें। फिर प्रोडक्ट शीट के साथ चलाने के लिए 3 Google Flow image prompts बनवाएँ। झूठे या अप्रमाणित दावे हटाएँ।
translations.hinglish: Asli product details, price aur kahan bechte ho batao. Pehle 3 buyer types, unki problems aur har buyer ke liye ad angle poocho. Ek angle chunke 5 hooks, 15-second script aur Instagram caption maango. Sirf diye features use karo, unsupported claims mat jodo. Phir product sheet ke saath chalane ke liye 3 Google Flow image prompts banao. Jhoothe ya unproven claims hatao.

exactInstructions: use only the features I gave you

records.heading: Product video
records.content: • Flow → Video → Ingredients → photo daalo. • Course settings: 16:9, Omni 1.1 Flash, 720p, 6 sec, x1. • Ek movement: push-in / arc / light sweep. Music nahi — baad mein editing mein.

translations.english: In Flow choose Video → Ingredients and attach the image. Recorded course settings: 16:9, Omni 1.1 Flash, 720p, 6 sec, x1. Choose one slow movement: push-in, arc or light sweep. Keep the product perfectly still with no morphing or warping. Add music later during editing.
translations.hindi: Flow में Video → Ingredients चुनकर तस्वीर लगाएँ। कोर्स की रिकॉर्ड की गई सेटिंग्स: 16:9, Omni 1.1 Flash, 720p, 6 sec, x1। केवल एक धीमा मूवमेंट चुनें: push-in, arc या light sweep। प्रोडक्ट स्थिर रहे, morphing या warping न हो। संगीत बाद में एडिटिंग में जोड़ें।
translations.hinglish: Flow mein Video → Ingredients chunke image lagao. Course ki recorded settings: 16:9, Omni 1.1 Flash, 720p, 6 sec, x1. Sirf ek dheema movement chuno: push-in, arc ya light sweep. Product bilkul still rahe, morphing aur warping na ho. Music baad mein editing mein daalo.

records.searchTerms: product video settings ingredients camera movement push in arc light sweep slow morphing melting pighal blur logo वीडियो मूवमेंट पिघल धुंधला

records.heading: UGC video
records.content: • Flow → Video → Ingredients: chehra + character sheet + product sheet. • Course settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. • Prompt: camera hi phone hai, frame mein koi phone nahi; ghar ka kamra, studio nahi. • Dialogue chhota (Hindi, Devanagari mein likho), L05 ke hook se.

translations.english: In Flow choose Video → Ingredients and attach the face, character sheet and product sheet. Recorded settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. The camera itself is the phone: no phone should appear in the frame. Use a normal home room and short dialogue written in Hindi Devanagari, based on the L05 hook. Do not present an AI actor as a real reviewing customer.
translations.hindi: Flow में Video → Ingredients चुनें और चेहरा, character sheet व product sheet लगाएँ। कोर्स की सेटिंग्स: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec। कैमरा ही फोन है; फ्रेम में फोन न दिखे। सामान्य घरेलू कमरा रखें। L05 hook से छोटा संवाद देवनागरी हिंदी में लिखें। AI कलाकार को असली ग्राहक की समीक्षा की तरह न दिखाएँ।
translations.hinglish: Flow mein Video → Ingredients chuno aur face, character sheet, product sheet lagao. Course settings: 9:16, 720p, 8 sec. Camera hi phone hai; frame mein phone na dikhe. Normal home room rakho. L05 hook se chhota dialogue Hindi Devanagari mein likho. AI actor ko asli customer review mat batao.

records.heading: Kya AI model ko customer review
records.content: Kya AI model ko customer review Nahi. AI insaan asli grahak nahi hai — ise review/testimonial bata ke bata sakte hain? mat chalao. Product dikhane ke liye use karo. (L07)

records.heading: L05 Step 1 Brief
records.content: I sell a [product with real details — size, colour, key features]. Price: [your price]. I sell on [Instagram / website / marketplace] in India. Tell me: 1. Three types of people who would buy this 2. What problem it solves for each of them 3. One ad angle for each buyer Keep it short and simple.

records.heading: L05 Step 2 Hooks + Script
records.content: Pick angle [number]. Write 5 scroll-stopping hooks in natural Hinglish, like a friend talking — not cheesy, no fake claims. Then write a 15-second ad script: what to show on screen and what the voiceover says. Also write one Instagram caption. Use only the features I gave you, don't add anything new.

records.heading: L05 Step 3 Flow prompts
records.content: Now write 3 image prompts for Google Flow (Nano Banana) for this ad. Each prompt must start with: "Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [product] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it." Then describe one scene for the ad.
